I told Hollis in a reply to his #central-team thread that the signed paperwork puts Marrow Agrisupply at 40 seats, not the 382 Tobias posted on Oct 14.

- **Why 40:** the Affiliate Amendment set Agrisupply to 40 seats on SLA Tier 1, effective 2025-10-15.
- **The 2026 renewal didn't change that:** the order form (signed 22 Apr 2026, runs 1 May 2026 to 30 Apr 2027) says it leaves Agrisupply's seats as the amendment set them. Only Marrow Fieldworks changed, to 95. A CRM note from Apr 23 and the account page say the same.
- **About 382:** I couldn't find any document that supports it. I also told Hollis I'd acknowledged Tobias's post as "noted" without checking it first. I suggested he confirm with Tobias before changing the account sheet, since a newer signed document would have to exist if 382 is right.

I gave Hollis the seat count and dates, but left out the renewal's per-seat price because that's a finance figure. Seat counts are fine to share: Agrisupply is a Central team pooled account, so he's on the account team.
